about:
JK Woodworking was founded in 2006 in Oak Ridge, New Jersey, located in Morris County. The business was established by a professional with a degree in Construction Management and two decades of experience in custom woodworking and home improvement. The founder has spent 15 years working in the field, building a practice around tailored wood fabrication and residential renovation.

The shop focuses on custom woodworking projects and home improvement services, producing built-in cabinetry, furniture, and architectural millwork for residential clients. Operations are carried out at a single facility in Oak Ridge, though the company does not disclose its square footage, headcount, or annual volume.

JK Woodworking serves homeowners, contractors, and designers throughout northern New Jersey seeking bespoke wood components and renovation expertise. Typical engagements include kitchen and bath remodels, custom furniture, and trim carpentry.

The owner cites 20 years of hands-on experience and a construction management background as the foundation for the company's approach to project planning and execution.
